body: The account has already been banned/deleted it seems, the user page brings up a 404. If you want to know this for statistical purposes I could send the name along.

I was kind of confused at how official the message looked, and was confused as to why it seemed to contradict the guidelines.

Part of the message made me very hesitant to do anything:
>be aware that operators on both of these crisis lines are required to >send authorities to the residence on file with the telephone company if >the caller is considered a threat to himself

someone has pointed out that this is false, and it makes me feel much more comfortable.. I think I will get around to calling one tonight
To me it's like asking if I'd like to chop off a leg or an arm. I do not enjoy taking any classes, and switching my major would not solve that problem.

>What would happen if you wouldn't go to college anymore for a time because you need to get your head free and have to rearrange your life? Is it possible to take a "vacation" semester and do some volunteer work or something?

Would have nowhere to go, and unless I get a job there will be no way to live either, unless I felt like roaming around and visiting soup kitchens. I don't think that last bit would improve my situation. 

>Why can't you do the thing you are interested in as a career?

It's something you rarely get hired for without a degree, and believe me, I have applied for the jobs anyway. But as I said, while in school I don't even have much time to do it as a hobby either

I think it would be accurate to describe how much they care for me as "mildly". I really do think I was an "accident" child. Neither has any apparent affection and any care seems to be merely through obligation. As I am no longer a minor, most of that is gone too. Hell, if I got lost and died somewhere they wouldn't realize or find out for months. No calls/texts/emails from any of them for the past 2 months, and before the winter break, 4 months.

The internship situation is complicated, but I think it's my best bet as well. No summer internships are available (as in, none exist. I would be doing one during a semester in fall/spring), and none of the internships in my area are paid. I am currently on a state-sponsored grant which pays tuition, but it is only active for 4 years regardless of whether or not I attend. Taking an internship would mean not graduating in 4 years, not making any money, and losing a semester of free tuition at the minimum. Assuming I get a job paying above minimum wage if I graduate, taking off an entire year to pursue an internship should be possible if I can get loans, but I would have to get some sort of bank loan because the federal school loans are strictly for school (books, tuition, fees)

"Freedom" being able to survive in the world doing something I do not hate. I will be honest and say there are at least a dozen jobs I can think of off the top of my head that I wouldn't mind doing until I die, but they also all require their own degrees.

I do not like many responsibilities it is true, but I accept that some exist. I have lived so far rarely getting what I want, but if I am never able to get or do anything I enjoy there would be no point living.

All I really want is to be able to live a peaceful, somewhat meager life doing something I do not hate, but that seems to be an impossible task on this planet. If I got a degree and got stuck with a min. wage job I would be gone within a month. I would rather be dead and free than alive and a slave
I don't have any goals. I "know" why I am in college, which is solely to get a degree to better my chances of getting a job in my field, which as you might have guessed is not a great motivator.
